items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: The transcript only identifies the interviewee as Paul Crawford. There is no mention of a relationship with a person named 'Paul Crawford' other than the interviewee being that person.

ctx.x: You ready? Let's see. The first thing I'd like to get is your name. I'm Bernd Stratus. And let's see, we're recording today. It's September the 22nd, 1960. We're aboard the steamer president. And we're Dr. Ede Splasser. That's right. Right at the foot of Canal Street. This is real one.
Let's get the Stratus family straight. There's so many of you. I know there's so many of you in the riverboat family that captains aboard the various boats.
